summary: The headquarters you begin with. It needs no power and is the only source of engineering dozers, the vehicles that raise the rest of the Ukrainian base.

sections.title: Produce dozers
sections.how: Select the headquarters, open the Build tab and press Engineering vehicle.
sections.body: Each dozer leaves the headquarters ready to build power plants, factories, defenses and the rest of the Ukrainian build list. Queue another one when the base must grow faster.

sections.title: Rally point
sections.how: Select the headquarters, press Rally point and left-click the ground.
sections.body: New dozers leave the headquarters and drive to the rally point. Changing the point only affects dozers produced afterwards. The marker shows while the headquarters is selected.

sections.title: Repair with a dozer
sections.how: Select a dozer and left-click the damaged headquarters.
sections.body: The dozer drives over and restores the headquarters a little every second until it is whole. The work costs half the build price pro rata, and the headquarters costs nothing, so repairing it is free. A second dozer does not speed it up.

sections.title: Sell the headquarters
sections.how: Select the headquarters and press Sell twice.
sections.body: It sells like any completed building. The refund is zero because it costs nothing, but every dozer in its queue is cancelled and refunded in full. Selling your last building loses the match.

strong: A rally point behind the line
tips: Build a power plant first: the headquarters gives no power.
Set a rally point near the construction site so new dozers start working at once.
Keep a dozer near the headquarters: the headquarters cannot repair itself.
Do not sell your last building unless you are ready to lose.
